subject: Post-call: BrightCart pricing profile & context sizing (tokens + windows)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@brightcart.com>, Alex Torres <alex.torres@brightcart.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-09T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: BrightCart pricing profile & context sizing (tokens + windows)

Hi Samantha / Alex — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and a few clarifying questions so we can size a pilot and a pricing proposal. I’ve attached a short usage snapshot and a few context examples.

Key signals from our call (what we captured):
- Primary use case: order search + multi-document summarization inside merchant admin (product pages, invoice history, support logs).
- Expected active users (initial): 12k monthly active users; high-frequency cohort ~1k DAU hitting the feature.
- Interaction pattern: user prompt ~1.1k tokens on average (structured context + query), completion ~950 tokens on average (multi-paragraph summary + bullet outputs).
- Avg tokens per interaction: ~2,050 tokens.
- Volume estimate (your estimate): 25M–60M tokens/month depending on feature rollout. Please confirm where you expect to land in month 1 vs month 6.

Context length needs:
- Typical sessions fit within 8k window (around 70% of interactions).
- Complex admin workflows (product + many attached notes) will need 32k occasionally (about 25%).
- Rare full-account exports / legal e-discovery paths might need 128k but <5% of volume — these we recommend routing to a specialized endpoint.

Pricing / unit-econ targets we discussed:
- Target unit cost: <= $750 per 1M tokens (target for commercial negotiating).
- Budget range indicated on call: $10k–$50k/month committed (you mentioned a pilot at $10k/mo and a potential expansion to $40–50k).
- We’ll model costs using a blended rate assuming 70% served on 8k-optimized model, 25% on 32k-optimized variant, 5% on 128k-specialty path.

Pilot proposal / ask:
1) Confirm target monthly token range we should model for pilot (pick one from: 25M, 40M, 60M).
2) Confirm whether you need the 128k path in pilot or hold for later (we can enable but it affects pricing).
3) Can you share a sample of typical admin prompts (we’ve attached context-examples.txt — another couple of short extracts would help tune completions).

Next steps we’ll take once you confirm:
- I’ll share a short pilot SOW + pricing table showing per-1M blended rate and expected monthly invoice at each volume tier.
- Propose a 6-week pilot: usage commitments, success metrics (latency <600ms p50, quality checks using your prompt set), and an option to convert to reserved capacity at month 3.

Attachments: BrightCart-usage-snapshot.csv (your raw traffic sample), context-examples.txt (anonymized prompts).

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the SOW draft.

—
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0198
From: Samantha Lee <samantha@brightcart.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Torres <alex.torres@brightcart.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-09T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: BrightCart pricing profile & context sizing (tokens + windows)

Thanks Karthik — super helpful. A couple quick clarifications: 
1) Pilot volume: we’re leaning toward a 40M token pilot (month 1) to get sufficient signal across the admin workflows.
2) 128k: we don’t need it in the initial pilot; we’ll enable it in month 3 if the legal exports team validates the request.
3) Examples: I attached two redacted admin prompts (in thread reply) — please treat as PII-free.

On the price target, $750/1M tokens is reasonable for the blended pilot rate, but our procurement team will push for a floor closer to $600/1M if we commit to $40k+/mo. Would you be open to a stepped discount based on committed spend?

Also: latency is important for our checkout-support flows — we asked for p50 and p95 targets in the call. We’ll expect the pilot to include latency dashboards.

Samantha
Head of Product, BrightCart
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-09T17:30:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Post-call: BrightCart pricing profile & context sizing (tokens + windows)

Looping Rishi here to draft a stepped discount schedule and show blended per-1M math.

Rishi — thoughts on a commercial that meets their ask (600–750 target band) while protecting unit economics? I’d start with:
- Pilot (40M): $720/1M blended — includes 8k + 32k mix.
- Commitment >$40k/mo: step to $650/1M blended.
- Commitment >$100k/mo: $580/1M blended and reserved capacity option.

We should include optional add-on fees for the 128k specialty path (charged at a premium).

Marissa
Enterprise Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha@brightcart.com>
Date: 2028-05-10T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: BrightCart pricing profile & context sizing (tokens + windows)

Thanks all — quick commercial note and next steps from my side:

Commercial assumptions (for internal modeling):
- Blended pilot rate calc (40M tokens):
  * 70% at 8k-optimized unit rate (assume $550/1M), 25% at 32k-variant ($900/1M), 5% at 128k path ($1,800/1M premium).
  * Blended = 0.70*550 + 0.25*900 + 0.05*1800 = $655 + $225 + $90 = $970/1M (list blended), propose negotiated pilot price $720/1M as Marissa suggested.
- Target negotiated floor at $600–650/1M for >$40k commitments.

Next steps:
1) Karthik: send SOW draft that includes a 6-week pilot at 40M tokens, pilot price $720/1M, KPIs (latency p50/p95 dashboards), and an option to convert to commitment-based pricing at month 3.
2) Samantha: confirm procurement lead and billing contact + whether they need a PO up front.
3) I’ll prepare an appendix showing the model assumptions and the per-tier breakouts (CSV attached).

Attaching a quick model: BrightCart-usage-snapshot.csv (for your internal review).

Rishi
Director, Commercial Strategy, Redwood Inference
